Subject: Customer executive roundtable — proposed windows and calendar holds

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, we'd like to lock in a half-day executive roundtable + a technical deep-dive for your team to review the pilot results and roadmap. To make scheduling straightforward — and to save travel approvals on your side — could you confirm which of these windows works best (we can be onsite in Houston or run hybrid):

Option A: Mon, Jul 19 (half day) — exec roundtable AM, tech deep-dive PM
Option B: Tue, Jul 20 (half day) — exec roundtable AM, tech deep-dive PM
Option C: Wed, Jul 21 (virtual fallback) — full day virtual

Quick asks:
- Expected senior attendees (titles fine) so we can align content and who presents
- Any travel/contract constraints (e.g., PO required before travel)
- AV needs (will you have a room with HDMI + single USB-C input?)

I've attached a draft agenda and AV checklist. Can you do me a favor and hold Jul 19–20 on your calendars tentatively while we confirm? We'll send a calendar hold from our side once we hear back.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear options. Jul 19/20 both look feasible as long as we keep travel within our corporate travel week. A few notes:
- Preferred: Jul 19 in Houston (in-person) so our execs can meet the Redwood team.
- Backup: Jul 21 (virtual) if any travel approvals slip.
- Expected attendees: Sofia Ruiz (Head of Data & AI), Miguel Torres (Infrastructure Lead), Laura Chen (Procurement, final approver).
- Procurement: We typically need a PO before incurring vendor travel expenses — procurement lead cc'd on follow-up.
- AV: Yes — standard conference room with HDMI preferred; we can provide a Logitech group mic.

Please send the calendar holds and a short logistics note on travel funding/PO timeline.

Best,
Sofia
